author: messiestobjects
body: Just checking, you know the ambrosia potion cures frog, right? If you didn't, that alone is a game changer.

author: permaculturegeek
body: If you have a decent manticore hood (T8), upgrade and use it. It gives your follower the rebirth spell which cures the curse and frog (and almost everything) - saves a lot of potions!

author: SaswordC
body:
You could hit the enrage cap then reset since her stat increase. Getting Snotra help with GSH too so i would recommend. You're not 250 and low AL so killing her in 1 go kinda tough.

Buggane for the def/res debuff.

Deific channel and Rhada Pact combo.

author: Apprehensive-Nose646
body: My GSH build takes less than 5 minutes. I mean,  i never timed it,  but it just took me about 2 minutes for regular Morrigan and it doesn't take much longer.  Not much to it, celestial staff full of arms of eos and a Rift summoner helmet. Hydrus pact ii. Ghosts, vss, kheper swarms.

author: Heavy_Vermicelli_263
body:
As a GSA, I just Rhada pact moggy curse off me onto my summons before it reaches zero.

I used to run one scary skelly to keep her perma debuffed, and therefore she'd constantly be trying to Dispel, and not hit me.

Now I'm a bit more tanky, can take a hit from Great Plague, so just run Ancient Dragon/Fey Kelpie combo and ward/deific/rhada loop.

author: skratch
body: Like somebody else mentioned , Guinevere’s hairpin makes fighting her trivial. If you don’t have that, there’s ambrosia like others mentioned. One thing folks haven’t mentioned is RS Corvus has Critical Poise, which will cause the curse to not tick down or tick extremely slowly as long as you keep critting
